title: Read-only roles may run slicer check

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The reviewer reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261119-142235-fa0b, project ork, item S341:

allow `slicer check --root WT` and `adj lint --root WT` for the reviewer as plain commands so the Check list can be run in full

Evidence: the reviewer's combined check command was denied automatically (it used `$?`), so two Check commands went unrun

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
Owner decision adj 504 (`roles.read-only-slicer-check` = add, 2026-11-19). `adj lint` was added by S458 (adj 499).

- `TestReadOnlyAllowlistIncludesSlicerCheck` in `internal/engine/perm_test.go`: `LocalReadOnlyAllowlist()` contains `Bash(slicer check*)`. Red today.
- Update any test that pins the exact read-only list to the new list.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the failing test and see it red.
2. Add `Bash(slicer check*)` after the other slicer entries in `LocalReadOnlyAllowlist`.
3. Docs: `docs/design.md` read-only allowlist lists slicer check, citing adj 504. Changelog entry with `slicer changelog add S470 --text "..."`.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
Acceptance criteria:
- A read-only role (local or cloud Claude) may run slicer check, including with --root after the subcommand.

Commands:
- `go test ./internal/engine -run TestReadOnlyAllowlistIncludesSlicerCheck -v`
- `go vet ./...`
- `go test ./...`
- `gofmt -l .` prints nothing.
- `slicer check` exits 0.
- `adj lint` exits 0.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: One commit on the slice branch, message "S470: read-only roles may run slicer check".
